intro: The most affordable winter base for Russian-speaking nomads: Goa has gathered a large Russian-speaking community. A simple electronic visa for up to 90 days.
climate: Tropical monsoon: October to April is dry and warm, May to September brings monsoons and torrential rain. Northern India has a mountain climate, while the south is hot year-round.
mentality: A multi-layered culture with thousands of regional particularities. Tolerance towards foreigners, especially towards Russian speakers in Goa.
language_note: Hindi and English are the official languages. English is widespread in tourism; in Goa there is Konkani and traces of Portuguese.
visa_note: An electronic visa for 30 or 90 days. The X-Visa is for families of Indian citizens, while the OCI grants lifelong status to people of Indian descent.
